args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure: `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 it must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

## Change
- `src/money.py`: replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Testing
- `tests/test_money.py` passes, including the banker's rounding case (`2.665 -> 2.66`).
- CI run ci-0001 on commit 08d3cd5986: passed.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
